sanskrit: agniṃ vayaṃ trātāraṃ yajāmahe menihanaṃ valagahanam | juṣāṇo agnir ājyasya menihā valagahā trātā trāyatāṃ svāhā ||
english: We worship Agni as our protector, the smiter of meni-disease, the slayer of valaga-affliction. May Agni, pleased with the ghee-offering, as smiter of meni, as slayer of valaga, as protector, protect us — svāhā!

sanskrit: indraṃ vayaṃ trātāraṃ yajāmahe menihanaṃ valagahanam | juṣāṇa indra ājyasya menihā valagahā trātā trāyatāṃ svāhā ||
english: We worship Indra as our protector, the smiter of meni-disease, the slayer of valaga-affliction. May Indra, pleased with the ghee-offering, as smiter of meni, as slayer of valaga, as protector, protect us — svāhā!

sanskrit: somaṃ vayaṃ trātāraṃ yajāmahe menihanaṃ valagahanam | juṣāṇaḥ soma ājyasya menihā valagahā trātā trāyatāṃ svāhā ||
english: We worship Soma as our protector, the smiter of meni-disease, the slayer of valaga-affliction. May Soma, pleased with the ghee-offering, as smiter of meni, as slayer of valaga, as protector, protect us — svāhā!

sanskrit: viśvān vayaṃ devāṃs trātṝn yajāmahe menighno valagaghnaḥ | juṣāṇā viśve devā ājyasya menihano valagahanas trātāras trāyantāṃ svāhā ||
english: We worship all the gods as our protectors, the slayers of meni-disease, the destroyers of valaga-affliction. May all the gods, pleased with the ghee-offering, as smiters of meni, as slayers of valaga, as protectors, protect us — svāhā!

sanskrit: bṛhaspatiṃ vayaṃ trātāraṃ yajāmahe menihanaṃ valagahanam | juṣāṇo bṛhaspatir ājyasya menihā valagahā trātā trāyatāṃ svāhā ||
english: We worship Bṛhaspati as our protector, the smiter of meni-disease, the slayer of valaga-affliction. May Bṛhaspati, pleased with the ghee-offering, as smiter of meni, as slayer of valaga, as protector, protect us — svāhā!

sanskrit: ye keśinaḥ prathamāḥ sattram āsata yebhir ābhṛtaṃ yad idaṃ virocate | tebhyo juhomi haviṣā ghṛtena- -aśvavān gomān ayam astu vīraḥ ||
english: Those who were the first long-haired ones to sit at the sattva-session, through whom that which shines here was brought — to those I pour the oblation with ghee. May this man be possessed of horses and cattle, a hero.

sanskrit: na rte dānāt tamaso mucyate pari dvināmnīṃ dīkṣāṃ vaśinīṃ ya āyat | prāsya keśāḥ suvate kāṇḍino bhavanti teṣāṃ brahmeśe vapanasya nānyaḥ ||
english: Without the gift of the dān, one is not freed from darkness. He who approaches the twofold-named, potent dīkṣā — his hair grows forward, they become nodose; of those rites the brahman is lord of the shaving, and no other.

sanskrit: yenāvapat savitā śīrṣṇo agre kṣureṇa rājño varuṇasya keśān | tena brahmāṇo vapatedam asya- -āsrāmo dīrghāyur ayam astu vīraḥ ||
english: With that razor with which Savitā first shaved the hair of the head, the hair of King Varuṇa — with that very razor the brahmin shall shave this man's hair. Free from āśrama-sin, long-lived may this man be — a hero.

sanskrit: mā te keśām̐ anu gād varca etat tathā dhātā dadhātu te | tubhyam indro varuṇo bṛhaspatiḥ savitā varca ā dadhan ||
english: Let not your vital lustre depart along with your hair — so let Dhātā establish it for you. May Indra, Varuṇa, Bṛhaspati, and Savitā bestow vital lustre upon you.

sanskrit: ā roha proṣṭhaṃ vi ṣahasva śatrūn avāsrāg dīkṣāṃ vaśinī hy ugrā | dehi dakṣiṇāṃ brāhmaṇebhyo atho mucyasva varuṇasya pāśāt ||
english: Mount the seat of honour, overpower your enemies — the potent, formidable dīkṣā has been discharged. Give the sacrificial fee to the brāhmaṇas; then you shall be freed from the snare of Varuṇa.

sanskrit: ye devāḥ puraḥsado 'gninetrā rakṣohaṇaḥ | te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ||
english: Those gods who are seated in the east, who have Agni as their leader, who are slayers of rākṣasas — may they protect us, may they shelter us. Homage to them, svāhā to them!

sanskrit: ye devā dakṣiṇāsado yamanetrā rakṣohaṇaḥ | te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ||
english: Those gods who are seated in the south, who have Yama as their leader, who are slayers of rākṣasas — may they protect us, may they shelter us. Homage to them, svāhā to them!

sanskrit: ye devāḥ paścātsado marunnetrā rakṣohaṇaḥ | te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ||
english: Those gods who are seated in the west, who have the Maruts as their leaders, who are slayers of rākṣasas — may they protect us, may they shelter us. Homage to them, svāhā to them!

sanskrit: ye devā uttarāsadaḥ somanetrā rakṣohaṇaḥ | te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ||
english: Those gods who are seated in the north, who have Soma as their leader, who are slayers of rākṣasas — may they protect us, may they shelter us. Homage to them, svāhā to them!

sanskrit: ye devā antarikṣasado bṛhaspatinetrā rakṣohaṇaḥ | te naḥ pāntu te no 'vantu tebhyo namas tebhyaḥ svāhā ||
english: Those gods who are seated in the atmosphere, who have Bṛhaspati as their leader, who are slayers of rākṣasas — may they protect us, may they shelter us. Homage to them, svāhā to them!
